name: Personal · nomad / expat
for: one person living across countries, several currencies, remote income

accounts.description: Everything you earn, in any currency; reports show it in the entity's functional currency
Income from work, wherever it is earned
Employment income, gross; tax withheld at source posts to the country's tax account. Bonuses and vested equity included
Invoices to clients as a freelancer or independent contractor
Distributions from a company you own (e.g. your LLC); the company books them against equity, you book them as income
Returns on savings and investments
Bank interest, bond coupons and dividends, gross of withholding
Realised gains on securities, crypto and property; losses are debits here
Income that is neither work nor investments
Money received from family and friends
Card cashback, points redeemed, referral and sign-up bonuses
Sales of personal items, prizes, anything else. A refund of an expense credits that expense instead
Everything you spend; groups follow COICOP 2018 divisions, taxes get one subtree per country
Where you live: long-term rent, short stays between bases, utilities and the household (COICOP 04, 05)
Long-term rent, agency fees and non-refundable deposits; a refundable deposit is a receivable, not an expense
Airbnb, aparthotels and monthly rentals between bases; hotels on trips go to Transport and travel
Electricity, gas, water and heating
Cleaning products, kitchenware, laundry, a cleaner
Storage unit for belongings kept in another country
Groceries versus eating out (COICOP 01, 11.1)
Supermarkets and markets
Eating and drinking out
Food delivered or picked up
Getting around a base and moving between countries (COICOP 07, 09.8, 11.2)

accounts.path: Expenses:Transport and travel:Public transport and taxis
accounts.description: Metro, bus, tram, taxis and ride-hailing in the city you live in

accounts.path: Expenses:Transport and travel:Car and scooter rental
accounts.description: Rentals, car-sharing, fuel, parking and tolls for rented vehicles

accounts.path: Expenses:Transport and travel:Flights, trains and buses
accounts.description: Airfares, seat and baggage fees, intercity trains, buses and ferries
Hotels and hostels while travelling; stays at a base go to Housing
Trip and baggage insurance

accounts.path: Expenses:Transport and travel:Tours, activities and entrance fees
accounts.description: Guided tours, excursions, museums and attractions while travelling
Health care and insurance across countries (COICOP 06)
International or private health insurance premiums; public-system contributions live in the country's tax subtree
Consultations, exams, dental and optical care
Medicines, supplements and first aid
Psychotherapy, coaching and counselling
Portuguese taxes and contributions. One subtree per country, so the year's total per jurisdiction is one balance; refunds credit the same account
Imposto sobre o Rendimento das Pessoas Singulares: withholding, instalments and the annual settlement. Eligible activities pay a 20% flat rate under NHR or its successor IFICI
Social security: self-employed contributions (21.4% of the relevant base) or the employee share withheld from salary

accounts.path: Expenses:Taxes Portugal:Other Portuguese taxes and fees
accounts.description: Imposto do Selo, IMI if you own property, AT and municipal fees
Brazilian taxes and contributions while resident there or still filing
Imposto de Renda: carnê-leão on income from abroad or from individuals, DARF payments and the annual adjustment
Contribuinte individual or facultativo contributions (20% plano normal, GPS code 1007; 11% simplified plan, code 1163)
Tax on financial operations charged by Brazilian banks on FX and card purchases abroad; kept apart from bank fees so the year's IOF is one balance
Taxes in any third country; give a country its own subtree like the two above once it matters on its own

accounts.path: Expenses:Taxes other countries:Income tax and withholding
accounts.description: Income tax paid or withheld elsewhere, e.g. US withholding on distributions or dividends

accounts.path: Expenses:Taxes other countries:Other taxes and fees
accounts.description: Tourist taxes, departure taxes, local levies and stamp duties
The cost of being allowed to live and work somewhere

accounts.path: Expenses:Immigration and documents:Visas and residence permits
accounts.description: Visa applications, residence permits and renewals, biometrics, government fees

accounts.path: Expenses:Immigration and documents:Documents, translations and legal help
accounts.description: Passports, apostilles, sworn translations, immigration lawyers, relocation services
What moving money between currencies and banks costs (COICOP 12.2). Exchange-rate differences post to the system FX gain/loss account, not here

accounts.path: Expenses:Bank and FX fees:Account, card and ATM fees
accounts.description: Monthly plans, card issuance, ATM withdrawal fees

accounts.path: Expenses:Bank and FX fees:FX conversion fees
accounts.description: Explicit conversion fees and spread charged by Wise, Revolut, N26 or a bank

accounts.path: Expenses:Bank and FX fees:International transfer fees
accounts.description: Wire, SWIFT and remittance fees (Remessa Online, Wise transfers)

accounts.path: Expenses:Bank and FX fees:Interest and late fees
accounts.description: Credit card interest, overdraft and late-payment fees
Phones, internet and subscriptions (COICOP 08)

accounts.path: Expenses:Communication and digital:Mobile, eSIMs and internet
accounts.description: Mobile plans, travel eSIMs and home internet

accounts.path: Expenses:Communication and digital:Streaming, media and news
accounts.description: Video and music streaming, newspapers and magazines

accounts.path: Expenses:Communication and digital:Software, apps and cloud
accounts.description: Personal apps, cloud storage, password manager, VPN
Costs of earning the remote income. If a company of yours pays them, they belong in its books
Coworking passes, day offices, cafés used as an office
Laptop, phone, monitor, peripherals and repairs
Tools and subscriptions used for work
Courses, books, conferences, professional associations
Filings and advice in more than one country
Money that goes to other people
Regular remittances and bills paid for parents
Gifts to family and friends, weddings, birthdays
Charitable donations and crowdfunding
Yourself and your free time (COICOP 03, 09, 13.1)
Clothes, shoes, luggage and travel gear
Haircuts, cosmetics, toiletries
Concerts, cinema, nightlife, museums, books and music

accounts.path: Expenses:Personal and lifestyle:Hobbies, sports and fitness
accounts.description: Gym, classes, sports gear, hobbies
Insurance other than health and travel (COICOP 12.1)
Personal liability, renters' contents and device insurance
Life, disability and income-protection premiums
What has no better home
Penalties, lost deposits, theft, unrecoverable amounts
Small cash spending you did not track by purpose. The system Uncategorized account is for statement lines still waiting to be classified
